title: Controls you can build with
summary: Build interactive interfaces with liquid buttons, switches, sliders, tabs, and accordions, alongside more reliable animation on slower devices.

groups.title: New features
items: Five ready-to-use React controls: PlasmaButton, PlasmaSwitch, PlasmaSlider, PlasmaTabs, and PlasmaAccordion.
Live component examples and documented props to help you get started.

groups.title: Fixes and improvements
items: Surfaces stay stable at low frame rates instead of flashing, growing too large, or disappearing.
Keyboard navigation, accessible IDs, nested accordions, and slider step alignment were refined during release review.

groups.title: Upgrading
items: Existing exports remain available. The new controls are additive, support React 18 and 19, and add no runtime dependencies.

title: More control over the material
summary: Tune the look and movement of your surfaces, and compose them into more flexible layouts. These highlights cover the accumulated changes included in 0.7.0.

groups.title: New features
items: Adjust shimmer, glow, color wash, grain, and background blur independently, including a clear-water look.
Control how surfaces appear and disappear with formIn, formOut, and formSpeed, and react when their entrance animation finishes.
Place the canvas yourself, use separate snapping groups, and layer another provider above a dialog scrim with a transparent background.

groups.title: Fixes and improvements
items: Better recovery after graphics-context loss, restored background images, and more complete graphics-resource cleanup.
Cleaner server rendering and improved React integration, including React 19 ref types.
